title: Requesting help for SV Battlers Taller Sprites

posts.author: PhoenixJP
posts.body:
Hello all,
I am looking for someone to help me with changing my current sv battlers sprites to a improved version (taller).  I have added a picture below that can, hopefully, explain what I need/want.
Hawke (circle) is too small.
Abel (arrow) is perfect.
I tried using Gimp, but my brain doesn't comprehend. I wouldn't mind speaking to someone one-on-one regarding this.  Also, would not mind paying.
I apologize if I have posted this in the wrong thread area as well.  Noob.
Thank you.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
PhoenixJP said:
I tried using Gimp, but my brain doesn't comprehend.
Click to expand...
This tells us nothing -
what
don't you comprehend?
The format for an SV battler spritesheet is right in the instructions. Click Help -> Contents -> Documentation -> Side-View Character Standards
The height/dimensions of the battler's image are irrelevant so long as every frame in your spritesheet has the
same
dimensions.
There are also many existing threads about this you should be able to find and reference with a quick Google - if you still are having problems getting your spritesheet formatted correctly, you don't need to offer to pay someone, you simply need to clearly state exactly which step of the process you're having trouble with.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
PhoenixJP said:
In the picture I uploaded, the character that is circled, is who I want larger like the character above him.  I don't understand how to change the image in Gimp. IF it is even possible to do so.
Click to expand...
Of course it's possible, GIMP is an image editor.
PhoenixJP said:
I just meant I am unsure how to fully use Gimp. I understand some things.
I have been searching all day for topics, but it seems no one has an answer for taller battle sprites in MZ.
Click to expand...
What I think you're asking is basic functionality of GIMP - it has nothing to do with RPG Maker battler sprites, and you wouldn't find GIMP tutorials on this site.
If you Google "GIMP image larger" you'd find articles such as this, teaching you how to find the Scale Image command in GIMP.
4.2. Change the Size of an Image for the screen
Note that this won't make the chibi battlers be tall - it will only make the entire image larger. It's still not entirely clear what you want, because you're showing us images in two entirely different art styles and it's (hopefully) common sense that you can't simply convert an image to be an entirely different style.
So it's unclear whether you simply want to make the RPG Maker-generated battlers to take up more space on the screen (which you do by scaling them up in GIMP) or whether you want them to be non-chibi characters with realistic proportions, which you can't do. You'd have to entirely redraw them (or commission someone else to do so).
